title: Page protection flags
description:
Turn `PAGE_*` protection values into words.

```
0x04 PAGE_READWRITE          -> read, write
0x20 PAGE_EXECUTE_READ       -> read, execute
0x104 PAGE_READWRITE|GUARD   -> read, write, guard page
0x40 PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE  -> read, write, execute (unusual!)
```
hints: The base is `protect & 0xFF` and the modifiers `protect & ~0xFFu` (lesson 6.03).
`VirtualQuery` reports these values for each region of your own process.
requirements: A table of the base values (`0x01` to `0x80`) and the modifier bits (`PAGE_GUARD 0x100`, `PAGE_NOCACHE 0x200`).
Split a value into its base and modifiers.
Flag write+execute as worth a closer look.
stretch: Print a whole memory map of your own process with `VirtualQuery` in a loop.
